semantics.invalid_condition_rule: Control-undetected trials are invalid measurement conditions, never candidate successes; they are accounted via invalid_condition_report and excluded from valid_trials.
semantics.accounting: Invalid trials are excluded from valid_trials and reported via invalid_condition_report; the preregistered bounds are min_valid_trials=93, max_valid_trials=144, target_interval_width=0.2, confidence_z=1.959963984540054.
semantics.frozen_before_data: These conditions are fixed before the first P1 garment capture and may not be redefined after data collection begins.

condition_classes.description: Frame degraded by defocus or subject/camera motion beyond measurement usability.
condition_classes.detection: Laplacian-variance or MTF-based sharpness screen against the session calibration baseline; any blur flagged on either the control or candidate frame of a matched pair.

condition_classes.description: Frame under/over-exposed relative to the locked session exposure (clipped highlights in the print region, crushed shadows, or lighting drift > 5% from the session calibration meter reading).
condition_classes.detection: Histogram clipping check on the garment region plus garment-centre meter comparison against the session baseline.

condition_classes.description: Printed region partially or fully occluded (hands, hair, carried objects, fold/wrinkle shadowing) in either frame of the matched pair.
condition_classes.detection: Operator review against the garment mask; occlusion flags logged with photo reference.

condition_classes.description: Garment silhouette not fully in frame, backdrop edge visible, or garment plane deviates from the sensor-parallel mounting beyond the 2% fiducial scale acceptance bound.
condition_classes.detection: Calibration-target fiducial scale check (left/right agreement within 2%) plus silhouette-in-frame check.

condition_classes.description: The matched control garment is not detected under the condition. Per the preregistered rule this is an invalid measurement condition, NEVER a candidate success.
condition_classes.detection: split_valid_invalid keeps only control-detected trials; control-undetected trials are routed to invalid_condition_report.
